name: bookprice_prediction
description:
Predict the sale price of books based on text features like their title, author, synopsis, categorical features like genre and numeric features like customer reviews and overall
    rating. This dataset originally stems from a 2019 MachineHack prediction competition:
    https://machinehack.com/hackathons/predict_the_price_of_books/overview
  
 Dataset found from the paper: Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
creator: Xingjian Shi, Jonas Mueller, Nick Erickson, Mu Li, Alexander J. Smola
citation: Shi, X., Mueller, J., Erickson, N., Li, M., & Smola, A. J. (2021). Benchmarking multimodal automl for tabular data with text fields. arXiv preprint arXiv:2111.02705.
